description: This is a Java JUnit test class (KeyLoaderTest) that verifies the behavior of the KeyLoader utility for loading cryptographic keys and certificates from files or keystores. It contains multiple test methods to test success and failure scenarios for loading keys and certificates.

classes.name: KeyLoaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various scenarios of the KeyLoader utility in loading cryptographic keys and certificates.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingKeyStore
methods.description: Tests that KeyLoader successfully loads a P12 keystore and retrieves a private and public key.

methods.name: testLoaderFailsForNonExistingKeyStore
methods.description: Tests that KeyLoader throws an IllegalArgumentException when attempting to load a non-existing keystore.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingKeyAndCertFiles
methods.description: Tests loading of private key and certificate chain from PEM files.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingKeyFile
methods.description: Tests loading only a private key from a PEM file.

methods.name: testLoaderSucceedsForExistingCertFile
methods.description: Tests loading only a certificate from a PEM file.

methods.name: testLoaderFailsForNonExistingKeyFile
methods.description: Ensures failure when attempting to load a non-existent private key PEM file.

methods.name: testLoaderFailsForNonExistingCertFile
methods.description: Ensures failure when attempting to load a non-existent certificate PEM file.

methods.name: testLoaderPkcs1PrivateKey
methods.description: Tests loading a private key from a PKCS#1 formatted PEM file.
